subject: Copywriting
title: Mercedes-Benz: Engineered Like No Other
description: A fast breakdown of Mercedes-Benz: Engineered Like No Other for builders.

hook.text: 'The best or nothing.' Gottlieb Daimler's motto became Mercedes-Benz's modern tagline.

buildup.text: Mercedes copy emphasizes engineering lineage: 'Invented the automobile.

twist.text: Mercedes recently softened its copy for younger audiences: 'Grow up.' The brand risked its heritage image to seem less.
